$comment: PROPOSED public-signal layout for the M3 access circuit. snarkjs emits OUTPUTS first, then PUBLIC INPUTS in declaration order. The gateway profile 'zkag-access-v1' (gateway/src/verification/profiles.ts) consumes exactly this order. Not confirmed by P1.

signals.name: root
signals.definition: Merkle root of the credential registry (depth 16)

signals.name: nonce
signals.definition: Gateway challenge nonce; must be constrained (e.g. nonceSquare <== nonce * nonce) so it cannot be optimised away

signals.name: resourceId
signals.definition: wiki=1, file-share=2, admin-panel=3; used in the nullifier

signals.name: epoch
signals.definition: floor(unix_seconds / EPOCH_SECONDS) as issued in the challenge

signals.name: roleMask
signals.definition: bit i set ⇒ role code i allowed (engineer=0, admin=1, contractor=2, finance=3)

signals.name: deptMask
signals.definition: bit i set ⇒ department code i allowed (all four = 15)

signals.name: issuerAx
signals.definition: EdDSA issuer public key x; gateway compares with TRUSTED_ISSUER_AX

signals.name: issuerAy
signals.definition: EdDSA issuer public key y; gateway compares with TRUSTED_ISSUER_AY
